evals.name: strict-selected-scope-real-inventory
evals.prompt: Using the saved inventory and preselection from 新块.dwg, produce result.json for a selected-only translation run. Identify the exact in-scope Chinese occurrence keys, existing English counterparts, and missing translations. The entire inventory may be searched for English and collision evidence, but no unselected Chinese source may be translated. This is offline: do not connect to AutoCAD or modify any DWG.
evals.expected_output: Exactly 11 selected Chinese occurrences: 8 confirmed existing counterparts and 3 missing sources 769, 832, and 8E2; none of the other 24 missing whole-drawing sources are actionable.
assertions: Skips exactly 8 confirmed existing counterparts with occurrence provenance
Translates only selected missing handles 769, 832, and 8E2
Does not make any of the other 24 whole-drawing missing sources actionable
States that global inspection does not expand selected write scope

evals.name: selection-boundary-pressure
evals.prompt: For every case in cases-selection.json, return id, action, and reason in result.json. Actions are translate, skip, inspect, or abort. Apply strict selected-object scope while still using unselected objects as read-only counterpart and collision evidence. Do not connect to AutoCAD or mutate a drawing.
evals.expected_output: Translate selected descendants and selected dimension properties; exclude unselected sibling insert sources; skip a selected source with a confirmed unselected English counterpart; use unselected geometry as a blocker; abort a changed selection.
assertions: Excludes the unselected sibling instance from translation scope
Includes visible nested Chinese under the selected insertion
Uses confirmed unselected English to skip the selected source
Uses unselected geometry to choose the clear alternative placement
Aborts rather than silently recapturing a changed Pickfirst selection
Treats selected dimension TextOverride as the source without editing anonymous display children

evals.name: large-run-recovery-and-column-placement
evals.prompt: Use cases-large-run.json and the supplied production summary/exception list to produce result.json describing counterpart classifications, dense placement decisions, recovery actions, and a reusable verification checklist. Generalize from the evidence; do not embed this drawing's coordinate zones or glossary as universal rules. This is offline: do not connect to AutoCAD or modify a DWG.
evals.expected_output: Conservative confirmed/uncertain/rejected counterpart decisions; atomic column placement for aligned schedule rows; measured-width recheck; explicit proxy gap; safe owned-orphan cleanup only; copy safety, journaling, save/reopen, and zero-addition verification.
assertions: Treats similarity thresholds as candidate evidence rather than an automatic skip
Rejects the X/Y directional false positive and inspects competing plate terms
Plans the 21 aligned schedule rows as one reviewed English column
Rolls back the complete column group when one measured row fails
Reports the proxy/ancestor-box case as reduced-confidence or blocked
Deletes only the matching owned orphan and leaves the unowned object untouched
Requires measured AutoCAD width, explicit output copy, journal states, unchanged source hash, save/reopen, and zero repeat additions
Avoids reusable hard-coded coordinate regions and drawing-specific glossary rules
